body.en:
Definition

Transformer protection detects electrical faults and abnormal thermal, magnetic, pressure or oil conditions, using complementary schemes whose coverage depends on construction and CT boundaries.

Classification / scope

  • Internal electrical; external electrical; thermal/cooling; magnetic overfluxing; oil/gas/pressure—select by actual transformer design.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Internal winding phase/earth/interturn faults, bushing faults and tank faults differ from external through faults, overload, overfluxing, loss of cooling and low oil.
  • Differential/REF, electrical backup, gas/pressure and temperature elements do not replace one another.Amechanical alarm cannot certify electrical insulation health.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Transformer protection electrical/thermal, magnetic, pressure/oil conditions ને complementary schemes થીશોધે છે; coverage construction/CT boundary પરઆધારિત છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Internal electrical/external/thermal-cooling/magnetic/oil-gas-pressure classes.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Internal phase-earth/interturn, bushing/tank અને external through fault/overload, V-f/cooling/oil જુદાં.
  • Diff/REF, backup, gas-pressure/T એકબીજાનાવિકલ્પ નથી; mechanical alarm થી electrical health proof નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A Buchholz relay is a gas/oil-flow protective device fitted in the pipe between the main tank and conservator of a suitable oil-filled transformer.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Gas chamber in the oil pipe, float/alarm mechanism, surge flap/flow element, conta cts, test/vent provisions and correct pipe slope/orientation.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Gas colle cts in upper chamber and displaces oil; alarm responds to the designed threshold.
  2. Internal severe fault can produce an oil surge toward conservator; flow element operates assigned trip conta cts.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Slow gas accumulation or oil-level change can operate an alarm element; rapid oil surge can operate a trip element according to design.
  • It requires the relevant conservator/pipe arrangement; it is not fitted meaningfully to every sealed/dry transformer.Gas may arise from faults or nonfault causes such as trapped air, so qualified analysis matters.
  • After operation, investigate source, gas/oil evidence and associated electrical records under authority; do not repeatedly reset and energise an un assessed transformer.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Buchholz suitable oil transformer ના main tank-conservator pipe માં gas/oil flow protective device છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Oil pipe chamber, float/alarm, surge flap/conta cts/test-vent/corre cts lope.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Gas upper chamber માં oil replace/alarm threshold.
  2. Severefaultsurgeconservatort રફ/flow element assigned trip.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Slowgas/level change alarm/rapid oil surge trip design મુજબ.
  • Conservator pipe જોઈએ; દર sealed/dry માંનહીં.Gas fault/trapped air બંનેથીહોઈશકે, analysis જરૂરી.
  • Operation પછી gas/oil/electrical records તપાસો; assessment વિન arepeatedreset-energise નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Transformer overcurrent and earth-fault protection provide coordinated backup or dedicated fault detection based on measured currents and the transformer/system earthing arrangement.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Pickup/time must tolerate permitted overload, motor start and magnetising inrush while coordinating downstream clearance and transformer through-fault withstand.
  • Ground-fault current may not transfer identically through vector-group/earthing connections; delta can circulate zero sequence without line-current transfer to another side.
  • OC/EF may be insensitive to low-current internal/interturn faults; main differential/REF and mechanical/thermal coverage remain necessary as applicable.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Transformer OC/EF measured I/earthing મુજબ coordinated backup/dedicated fault detection આપે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Pickup/time overload, start/inrush tolerate/downstream/through fault withstand coordinate.
  • Earth Ivector/earthing થીજુદું; delta માં zero-sequence circulate થાયબીજી side પર line I તરીકેનહી.
  • OC/EF low internal/interturn માં insensitive; diff/REF/mechanical thermal જરૂરી.

body.en:
Definition

Transformer differential compares currents referred to a common electrical base after compensating ratio, phase displacement and appropriate zero-sequence effects.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Winding current magnitudes differ with voltage; CT polarity, vector group, tap range and CT burdens must be represented correctly.Numerical phase compensation must not be duplicated by an unintended external CT connection.
  • Percentage bias restrains ratio/tap/CT error during through current; saturation and unequal DC offset can still challenge security.High-set stages need a separate inrush/fault study.
  • Magnetising inrush often has distinctive harmonics/waveform; second-harmonic restraint/blocking is one method, not an infallible universal disc rim in at or.Some internal faults and modern cores challenge it.
  • Operate on Idiffagainst declared pickup/restraint after valid compensation; use test phasors representing internal, external, inrush and CT failure cases.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Ideal side rated current I=S/(√3V).For 25 MVA 66/11k V, the 66k Vside≈218.7 Aand 11k Vside≈1312.2A.
  2. CT 300/1 and 1500/1 give≈0.729 Aand 0.875 Aat rated load; raw secondaries do not balance.Arelay must refer them to the same base before comparing.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Transformer differential ratio, phase displacement/zero-sequence compensate કરી common base currents compare કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Side currents voltage થીજુદા; CT polarity/vector/tap/burden જરૂરી; unintended external CT+numerical double compensation નહીં.
  • Bias ratio/tap/CT errorrestrain; DC/saturation challenge રહે; high-set અલગ study.
  • Inrush harmonic/waveform; second harmonic એક method છે, infallible નહીં; core/fault challenges છે.
  • Compensation પછી pickup/restraint; internal/external/inrush/CT failure phasors test કરો.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. I=S/(√3V); 25 MVA 66/11k V માં 66 side≈218.7A/11 side≈1312.2A.
  2. CT 300/1/1500/1 થી≈0.729A/0.875A; raw secondaries balance નથી; common base reference જોઈએ.

title.en: 5.5 Restricted earth fault: zone and sensitivity
title.gu: 5.5 Restricted Earth Fault: Zone તથા Sensitivity

h.en: Restricted earth fault: zone and sensitivity
h.gu: Restricted Earth Fault: Zone તથા Sensitivity

body.en:
Definition

Restricted earth-fault protection compares residual phase currents with the neutral current within a defined grounded winding zone to detect internal earth faults selectively.

Classification / scope

  • High-impedance and low-impedance biased REF; select according to CT data, neutral arrangement and scheme requirements.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Phase CT s and neutral CT bound the restricted zone.External earth-fault currents ideally balance; internal earth fault produces imbalance.
  • High-impedance REF uses matched CT s, stability voltage/resistor design and suitable nonlinear limiting where required; low-impedance biased REF uses a different measuring/restraint implementation.
  • REF is not unrestricted residual OC and does not automatically detect every phase/interturn fault or give 100%coverage for every neutral/fault impedance.
  • Never insert/remove CT s econdary circuits live to demonstrate external balance; use isolated secondary injection with an approved test block.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

REF grounded winding ના defined zone માં phase-residual/neutral Icompare કરી internal earth fault select કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • High-Z/low-Zbiased REF; CT/neutral/scheme મુજબપસંદ.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Phase CT/neutral CT zone bound; external balance/internal imbalance.
  • High-ZREF matched CT/stability V/resistor/required limit er; low-Zbiased REF જુદી implementation.
  • REF unrestricted OC નથી; દર phase/interturn/neutral-fault Z માં 100%guarantee નહીં.
  • External balance માટે live CT insert/remove નહીં; approved isolated injection જ.

body.en:
Definition

Transformer mechanical/thermal/magnetic supervision detects pressure, oil-surge, excess flux and heat conditions that may require an alarm or trip independently of differential current.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • PRV is a pressure-relief device; it may have an operation contact but a contact is not its primary pressure-relief mechanism.OSR commonly supervises oil surge in the OLTC conservator connection, where fitted.
  • Buchholz main-tank gas/flow, OLT COS Rand PRV have different locations/functions; follow exact OEM nomenclature and trip matrix.
  • Overfluxing arises from excessive V/fand can overheat core/structural parts.Overheating also arises from overload, cooling failure, hot joints or low oil and is monitored by appropriate sensors/models.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. With approximate sinusoidal E=4.44f NΦ, flux∝V/f.For 1.05 pu Vand 0.95 pu frequency, V/f≈1.1053 pu.
  2. The resulting about 10.53%overflux ratio is a calculation, not a permissible duration/trip curve; manufacturer V/ftime capability governs.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Mechanical/thermal/magnetic supervision pressure, oil-surge, flux/heat શોધે અને diff I વિનાપણ alarm/trip જોઈશકે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • PRV pressure-relief device/contact optional; OSR fitted OLTC pipe માં oil surge જુએ છે.
  • Buchholz, OLTCOSR/PRV સ્થાન-કાર્યજુદાં; OEM names/matrix અનુસરો.
  • Excess V/f થી core/structure heat; overload, cooling, joints/lowoil થીપણ T વધે; appropriate sensors જોઈએ.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. E=4.44f NΦથી flux∝V/f; V 1.05 pu/f 0.95 pu થી≈1.1053 pu.
  2. આશરે 10.53%ratio ગણતરી છે, allowable duration curve નહીં; OEMV/ftime મુજબ.

body.en:
Definition

A transformer protection specification states both winding voltage bases, ratings, measurement/neutral arrangements, main and backup functions and the devices that remove every relevant source.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Retain source 11/220k Vas a valid step-up example.Illustrative 100 MVA: 11k VCT 6000/1A, 220k VCT 300/1A; generator/grid sources may both feed internal faults.
  • Illustrative 220/66k V, 160 MVA: CT 600/1 Aand 1600/1 Aon respective sides; 66/11k V, 25 MVA: CT 300/1 Aand 1500/1A.The ratios are study candidates, not sufficient proof of CT s atu ration/REF suitability.
  • Primary: HV breaker/CT→transformer→LVCT/breaker, neutral CT/NER where required, gas/pressure/temperature inputs.Control: compensated 87T/REF+OC/EF+mechanical/T/Vf→lockout→both-side breakers/field where appropriate.
  • Declare vector group, taps, CT class/burden, VT ratios, DC supply, breaker fault/TRV ratings, trip conta cts and reset rules.Asource nameplate voltage alone is not a complete power/control specification.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Transformers pec બંને voltage bases, rating, measurement/neutral, main-backup/every-source isolation બતાવે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Source 11/220 step-up રાખો; illustrative 100 MVA માં 11 CT 6000/1A/220 CT 300/1A; બંને sources fault feed કરી શકે.
  • Illustrative 220/66, 160 MVA માં CT 600/1A/1600/1A; 66/11, 25 MVA માં 300/1A/1500/1A; candidates જ, saturation/REF proof નહીં.
  • Primary HV-CB/CT→TF→LVCT/CB, required neutral CT/NER/mechanical; control 87T/REF+OC/EF+T/Vf→lockout→both CB/required field.
  • Vector group, taps, CT class/burden, VT/DC, CB fault-TRV/trip-reset લખો; voltage એકલું complete spec નથી.

title.en: 5.8 Bus-bar protection requirements and unit schemes
title.gu: 5.8 Bus-bar Protection Requirements તથા Unit Schemes

h.en: Bus-bar protection requirements and unit schemes
h.gu: Bus-bar Protection Requirements તથા Unit Schemes

body.en:
Definition

Bus-bar protection rapidly and selectively isolates an internal bus fault by tripping all sources connected to the faulted protection zone while keeping secure for large external through faults.

Classification / scope

  • Unit differential: high-Z/low-Zbiased with suitable check-zone/selectivity arrangements.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Bus faults can involve very high current, arc damage and wide outages; low bus impedance does not imply low fault current.CT s atu ration and isola tor replicas are important security issues.
  • Unit bus differential sums currents from every bay in the selected zone.High-impedance and low-impedance biased schemes have different CT/stability requirements.
  • Acheck zone and disconnector-position logic may validate/select dynamic bus zones.Bad/intermediate/stale switch status requires engineered alarm/block/fallback—not blind zone reassignment.
  • Protection must account for bus coupler/section breakers, maintenance, CT dead zones and end faults; an SLD without CT locations does not define bus coverage.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Bus protection internal fault માં zone સાથે connected source strip કરી fast selective isolation આપે અને external through fault માં secure રહે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Unit diff: high-Z/low-Zbiased/check-zone/selectivity.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Bus fault high I/arc/wide outage; low Z એટલે low I નહીં; CT s atu ration/replicas critical.
  • Unit diff દર bay I સુમે; high-Z/low-Zbiased ના CT/stability requirements જુદા.
  • Check zone/disconnector logic select કરે; bad/stale status માં designed fallback, blind reassign નહીં.
  • Coupler, maintenance, dead zone/end fault cover; CT locations વિના SLD coverage નથી.

h.en: Non-unit bus protection and breaker backup
h.gu: Non-unit Bus Protection તથા Breaker Backup

body.en:
Definition

Non-unit bus protection uses local/non-differential conditions and coordination to identify a bus fault; breaker-failure protection clears remaining fault sources when a commanded breaker does not interrupt as required.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Overcurrent/time or reverse-blocking schemes may provide non-unit bus coverage but can have speed/selectivity limits and depend on feeder signals.
  • Typical BF logic starts from an eligible trip, checks current/contact criteria, may retrip locally, then trips connected upstream/adjacent source breakers after a studied delay.
  • Delay must exceed verified breaker clearing/measurement tolerances but remain within system/equipment limits.No one universal BF time is supplied.
  • Aconta cts-only or current-only implementation has limitations; low-current faults, open poles and stuck auxiliary conta cts require the manufacturer’s complete logic.The classroom model declares its simplified current criterion.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Non-unit local conditions થી bus fault select કરે; breaker-failure command છતાં fault interrupt નથાયત્યારે remaining sources clear કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • OC/time/reverse blocking non-unit coverage આપેપણ speed/selectivity/feeder-signal limits છે.
  • BF eligible trip થી start/current-contact check/local retrip/પછી studied delay એ adjacent source strip.
  • Delay verified clearing/tolerance થીવધારે/limits નીઅંદર; universal BF time નથી.
  • Contact-only/current-only limits છે; actual complete logic જોઈએ; classroom model current criterion declare કરે છે.

title.gu: 5.9 11k V, 66k V, 400k V Bus Power/Control Specification

h.gu: 11k V, 66k V, 400k V Bus Power/Control Specification

body.en:
Definition

A bus protection specification documents bus topology, CT boundaries, zone selection, check protection, trip distribution and breaker failure so every connected source is handled correctly.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Illustrative 11k V sectioned bus: 12k Vclass, 1250A, 25k A candidate; bay CT 400/1 Aand coupler CT 800/1 Aneed numerical ratio normalisation or compatible high-Zdesign.
  • Illustrative 66k V double bus: 72.5k Vclass, 2000A, 31.5k A candidate; bay CT 600/1A, disconnector replica and coupler current are included.
  • Illustrative 400k Vbus: 420k Vclass, 4000A, 50k A candidate, CT 2000/1 Aand independent protection/DC paths per reliability design.Complex breaker-and-a-half zones must match actual topology.
  • Primary diagram marks each bay CT and disconnectors; control matrix lists zone→all affected CB trip coils/BF starts/remote trips with test links, supervision and alarms.All rating examples require actual studies.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Busspec topology, CT boundaries, zone selection, check/trip/BF document કરીદર source handle કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Illustrative 11 sectioned: 12 class/1250A/25k A; bay CT 400/1A/coupler 800/1A નામ ismatchnormalise/compatible high-Zdesign જોઈએ.
  • Illustrative 66 double: 72.5 class/2000A/31.5k A/bay CT 600/1A/replica-coupler included.
  • Illustrative 400 bus: 420 class/4000A/50k A/CT 2000/1A/independent DC-protection; breaker-and-a-half actual zones match.
  • Primary દર bay CT/DS; control zone→affected CB/BF/remote/test links-supervision-alarm; examples actual study થી verify.

body.en:
Definition

Adaptive protection changes an approved protection response or setting group according to validated system conditions while maintaining defined security, dependability and change control.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Inputs may include topology, island/grid status, generation availability and fault studies; fresh data quality, authorisation, group validation and a safe fallback are required.
  • Integrated protection/control shares measurements, events and commands through IED s/gateways/SCADA; time stamps, settings audit, cyber security and independent local trip paths remain essential.
  • SCADA visibility does not make the wide-area server the sole fast protection path.Acommunications failure must not silently select an unsafe pickup/reach group.
  • Test topology transitions, stale/bad data, unauthorised changes and restoration; offline adaptive-group examples are logic models, not deployed self-learning relay control.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Adaptive protection validated system conditions મુજબ approved response/group બદલે અને security/dependability/change control જાળવે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Topology, island-grid, source/study inputs; fresh quality, authority, validation/fallback જોઈએ.
  • IED/gateway/SCADA data-events-commands શેરકરે; time, audit, cyber/independent local trip જરૂરી.
  • SCADA serversolefastpath નહીં; comms failure unsafe group select નકરે.
  • Transitions/stale-bad/unauthorised/restoration test; offline groups logic છે, deployed self-learning control નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A source-listed supervised performance guide, not a claim that a test, reading, date or instructor signature has been completed.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Approved multi-current test set, transformer relay, vector-group/CT data and isolated trip monitor.
  2. Refer both sides to common base with correct into-zone phasors; verify internal compensation and do not compensate the vector group twice.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Read the actual device manual, ratings, settings and approved safe plan; identify energy sources, trip destinations and all blocked/isolation boundaries.
  2. Power OFF: check instrument ranges, polarity, burdens, CT test blocks, grounding and output isolation; no interlock/protection bypass.
  3. Test balanced load, external through current and CT mismatch points for restraint.
  4. Test internal points above pickup/slope and boundary tolerances; review harmonic inrush restraint with a capable approved test set, not by inventing a physical transformer fault.
  5. Write actual readings with units, test conditions, quality and evidence only after genuine performance; computed traces stay in separate labelled columns.
  6. Return settings/links to the documented authorised state, isolate/discharge, and close the instructor checklist without inventing observations.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Official practical 5; source Unit/CO 5; 2 suggested hours.No individual compulsory star is marked.
  • Use offline models or approved isolated secondary injection under qualified supervision; 24 VDC mock construction does not authorise high-energy relay/CT/VT tests.Source variac is not isolation.

Worked example / setting interpretation

  1. For declared Imin 0.3A/slope 0.2, I1=5A, I2=−4.8 Are strains; I2=3 Awith I1=5 Aoperates in the classroom one-slope model.

Reliability and safety checks

  • Unexpected differential: check polarity, phase mapping, ratio/taps, zero-sequence compensation and test-set phasor reference.
  • Never open a live CT s econdary, short a VT s econdary, lift protective earth or attach unsafe scope grounds.Actual switchyard operations require site authority/permit.

body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Source-listed supervised પ્રયોગમાર્ગદર્શિકા છે; test/readings/date/signature પૂર્ણથયાનો દાવો નથી.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Approved multi current set/TF relay/vector-CT data/trip monitor.
  2. Common base/into-zone phasors; internal compensation verify/double compensation નહીં.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Actual manual, ratings/settings/safe plan વાંચો; sources/trip destinations/isolation ઓળખો.
  2. OFF માં ranges, polarity, burden, CT blocks, earth/output isolation check; protection bypass નહીં.
  3. Balanced load/external/mismatch માં restraint test.
  4. Internal above/boundary test; capable set થી harmonic restraint, physical fault invent નહીં.
  5. ખરેખરપ્રયોગપછી actual readings units/conditions/evidence સાથેલખો; computed trace અલગ label માં.
  6. Settings/links authorised state માંપરત/isolate-discharge/checklist close; readings invent નહીં.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Official પ્રયોગ 5; source Unit/CO 5; 2 suggested hours; individual compulsory star નથી.
  • Offline model/qualified supervised isolated injection જ; 24 Vmock થી high-energy CT-VT test permission નહીં; variacisolation નથી.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ / Settingનું અર્થઘટન

  1. Declared Im in 0.3A/slope 0.2 માં I1=5A/I2−4.8 Are strain; I1=5A/I2=3 Aoperate.

વિશ્વસનીયતા તથા સલામતી

  • Unexpected માં polarity, phases, ratio/taps/zero-sequence/test reference જોવો.
  • Live CT open/VT short/protective earth remove/unsafe scope ground નહીં; actual switchyard authority-permit થી.

Actual Observation માટે ખાલી Record

body.en:
Definition

A source-listed learning activity with a structured evidence guide; completion is not pre-certified.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Select an authorised safe topic/source and define questions.
  2. Collect verifiable evidence, prepare an original diagram, and distinguish source facts from your interpretation.
  3. Conclude with protection lessons, limitations and viva discussion; use the length needed, no invented mandatory page count.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Choose a documented topology/adaptive-setting or digital-substation case; draw protection, control, communication and data-quality boundaries.
  • Discuss approved group changes, stale data, cyber access, time synchronisation, local trip independence and communication failure fallback.
  • Deliver a cause–effect table and proposed tests; do not deploy an unsupervised remote-control or self-learning setting change.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Source-listed શૈક્ષણિક પ્રવૃત્તિ માટે evidence-based માર્ગદર્શન છે; પૂર્ણ થયાનું પ્રમાણપત્ર નથી.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Authorised safe topic/source પસંદ કરી પ્રશ્નો નક્કી કરો.
  2. ચકાસી શકાય તેવા evidence મેળવો, original diagram બનાવો અને source facts/પોતાનું અર્થઘટન અલગ રાખો.
  3. Protection lessons, limitations તથા viva ચર્ચા સાથે પૂર્ણ કરો; જરૂર મુજબ length રાખો, બનાવટી compulsory pages નહીં.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Documented adaptive/digital substation case પસંદકરી protection/control/comms/quality boundaries દોરો.
  • Approved groups/stale data/cyber/time/local trip/fallback સમજાવો.
  • Cause-effect/tests આપો; unsupervised remote/self-learning setting deploy નહીં.

h.en: Activity 5: Historical blackout: causes and consequences

body.en:
Definition

A source-listed learning activity with a structured evidence guide; completion is not pre-certified.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Select an authorised safe topic/source and define questions.
  2. Collect verifiable evidence, prepare an original diagram, and distinguish source facts from your interpretation.
  3. Conclude with protection lessons, limitations and viva discussion; use the length needed, no invented mandatory page count.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Choose one historical blackout and use dated official investigation/system-operator reports where available; separate initiating fault, protection response and cascading conditions.
  • Draw an evidence-based timeline of loading, voltage/frequency, relay operations and restoration; mark missing or disputed evidence instead of guessing.
  • Explain consequences and lessons in coordination, system operation, communications and restoration; avoid claiming one relay caused an entire blackout without evidence.

a.en: In the main-tank/conservator pipe of suitable oil-filled construction.Gas accumulation and rapid oil flow have different responses; sealed/dry designs and OLTC compartments need their own applicable devices.
a.gu: Suitable oil-filled main tank/conservator pipe માં; gas તથા rapid oil flow ના responses જુદાં; sealed/dry/OLTC માટે applicable devices જુદાં.

a.en: Winding voltages, currents and vector-group phase shifts differ.CT ratio, tap and zero-sequence effects must be referred consistently; duplicate phase compensation or wrong polarity can cause false differential.
a.gu: Winding V/I/vector phase જુદાં છે; CT/tap/zero-sequence common base પર મેળવો; double phase compensation/wrong polarity false trip કરે.

a.en: REF compares phase residual and neutral current within CT boundaries for selective internal earth-fault detection.Unrestricted EF responds to residual/neutral current without the same restricted-zone differential selectivity.
a.gu: REF phase-residual/neutral I CT-boundary માં compare કરે; unrestricted EF પાસે એ જ restricted-zone comparison/selectivity નથી.

q.en: Are PRV and OSR the same?

a.en: PRV relieves excess pressure and may provide a contact.OSR commonly detects oil surge in a fitted OLTC pipe arrangement; neither name alone specifies universal trip outputs.
a.gu: PRV pressure release કરે/contact હોઈ શકે; OSR fitted OLTC pipe માં surge જુએ; નામથી universal trip output નક્કી નથી.

a.en: Excess V/fraises core flux under approximate sinusoidal conditions and can heat core/structural metal.Actual allowable magnitude/duration comes from the manufacturer, not a universal percentage rule.
a.gu: Excess V/f થી flux/core-structure heat વધે; allowable magnitude/time OEM curve થી, universal percentage થી નહીં.

q.en: Why is a bus fault severe?

a.en: Many sources may feed a low-impedance common node, producing high current and a wide outage.All connected infeed paths in the faulted zone must clear while external through faults must remain secure.
a.gu: અનેક sources low-Z bus માં high I આપે/wide outage થાય; faulted-zone ની sources clear કરવી અને external faults માં stable રહેવું.

q.gu: BF ક્યાંથી start તથા complete થાય?

a.en: An eligible protection trip starts the scheme.Persistent current/status criteria and studied delay may lead from local retrip to backup source isolation; actual topology and low-current logic govern.
a.gu: Eligible protection trip થી start; persisting current/status/studied delay થી local retrip/પછી backup isolation; actual topology/low-current logic જરૂરી.

a.en: SCADA provides supervisory information/control, integration and audit; fast protection normally retains independent local paths.Adaptive groups need validated fresh data, authorisation and a defined communications-failure fallback.
a.gu: SCADA supervisory integration/control/audit આપે; fast protection independent local path રાખે; adaptive group માટે fresh validated data/authority/fallback જોઈએ.
